full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 77 S. 31 May 2010 VICE-MAYOR JANET DE LEON-MERCADO Taytay, Rizal Dear Vice-Mayor De Leon-Mercado: 20JO This has reference to your earlier letter asking this Department's legal opinion on whether or not the veto power of the local chief executive is applicable as regards the following Resolutions passed by the Sangguniang Bayan of Taytay, to wit: Resolution No. 16- Kapasyahang Nagtatakda sa Pagkakahalal ng Tagapangulo, Pangalavvang T agapangulo at Tatlong (3) Miyembro ng Ibat-ibang "Standing Working Committees" ng Sangguniang Bayan ng Taytay, Lalawigan ng Rizal; and Resolution No. 17- Designating Sangguniang Bayan Members as Representatives for Various Special Bodies and Council Pursuant to Local Government Code of 1991, Sangguniang Bayan Ordinances and Resolutions, Executive Order No. 320 series of 1988 and Republic Act No. 6975 In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 32, series ofeooq. In the said legal opinion, we opined that not all resolutions approved by the sanggunian concerned are to be submitted to the local chief executive for his approval and/or veto. Hereto attached is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion for your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Ls/17 (4 Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: . DOQU IV .
